audit.why: 49.9% over 487 games at 6/10 fits: Maokai owns the first two levels, the middle is even, Gangplank owns 6 and first item, and the late game splits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts were wrong at five rows. They gave Levels 1-3 to Gangplank while the content says 'Levels 1-3 are Maokai's' outright, and gave 2+ items to Gangplank while whys[6] calls the late game 'a genuine coinflip between roam and split'.
audit.why: The opening rows are the ones that matter here — a Gangplank told he wins level 1 will place a keg into Sapling Toss range and lose the lane in the first minute.
audit.corrected: win[0], win[1], win[2], win[4], win[6] and phases[0], [1], [2], [4], [6] brought onto the packet chart as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr, report[0], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and report[5] all say to cleanse the root 'with Q' — Gangplank cleanses with Remove Scurvy (W), and the content layer of the same page says so correctly. The full layer also carries no numbers at all: Twisted Advance is 14/13/12/11/10s at 525 range and he is UNTARGETABLE during the dash, and Sapling Toss is 18s at 1100 range, which is the tool that actually kills your kegs.
audit.why: The untargetable dash is why timed burst on his approach whiffs, and the 1100-range sapling is why keg placement, not trading, decides the early lane. Neither reached the page.
audit.corrected: Cleanse attributed to W throughout; real ranges and cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0], the phase whys and the content spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nature's Grasp is described only as an 'R knockback'.
audit.why: It is a 3000-range advancing wall that ROOTS, and Gangplank has no dash — it cuts the retreat, which is a Flash decision, not a damage one.

notes: packet.defects was right that no Maokai ability was ever named — Bramble Smash, Twisted Advance, Sapling Toss, Sap Magic and Nature's Grasp are now written in with their real cooldowns and ranges. The 'cleanse it with Q' instruction appeared in five places in the full layer while the content layer correctly said Remove Scurvy; fixed to W. packet.suspectNames flagged 'Powder Kegs' and 'Your Cannon Barrage': both false positives. The packet chart and content whys[4] disagreed about Level 6 — the whys hedged to 'skill', the packet says Gangplank — and I resolved to the packet, since Cannon Barrage against a 130s teamfight wall is a clear lane-stage edge.
